name: MCP Server Playground
tagline: Test, debug and validate your MCP servers with an interactive playground
description: MCP Server Playground is a comprehensive testing environment for Model Context Protocol servers. Test your MCP tools, validate server configurations, inspect JSON-RPC requests/responses, and simulate client interactions without leaving your browser. Perfect for MCP developers who need to iterate quickly.
target_audience: MCP server developers, AI tool builders, Claude/Cursor extension developers
features: JSON-RPC message inspector with syntax highlighting
Support for stdio and SSE transports
differentiation: Web-based, no CLI needed, visual request/response inspector, scenario replay
estimated_traffic: MCP trending on GitHub, Claude Desktop adoption growing
